description: One $5,000 award a year for an enlisted soldier at Fort Bragg enrolled at Campbell University in a STEM major.
eligibility_text: Must serve as an enlisted soldier at Fort Bragg. Must be currently enrolled at Campbell University. Must be pursuing a major in a STEM discipline. The page states no minimum GPA, class year or citizenship requirement.
notes: Split out of the retired 'afcea-stem-scholarship' umbrella on 2026-09-19. The umbrella averaged 13 named awards into eligibility true of none of them. Restricted to Campbell University (Buies Creek, NC), hence states_allowed NC - a geographic restriction the umbrella recorded as nationwide. Page status on 2026-09-19: 'Applications closed!'. The page publishes no application deadline; 'no later than May 1, 2026' is the mailed-documents date for the closed cycle, recorded as cycle.deadline_month 5.
title: AFCEA Susan Lawrence Soldier for Life Scholarship
